projectDescription: FluidVoice is a free, open-source macOS dictation app that uses on-device speech models and the optional Fluid-1 AI model to transcribe, format, and post-process voice input into any app — with zero data leaving your Mac.
keyFeatures: On-device speech-to-text with multiple model options (Nemotron, Parakeet, Whisper, Apple Speech)
Fluid Intelligence — local AI model for smart formatting, capitalization, and post-processing
Command Mode — control macOS by voice (launch apps, run shortcuts, automate workflows)
Write/Edit Mode — dictate or rewrite text in any text field across any app
Per-app prompt profiles — adaptive tone and formatting per application
System-wide global hotkey for instant voice capture from anywhere
AI post-processing via OpenAI, Groq, custom providers, or fully local Fluid-1
Custom dictionary — text replacements and vocabulary boost terms
Local REST API for scripting and third-party integrations
Audio history with budget controls and ZIP export
Free and open source under GPLv3
